question: Who was the chief coordinator for the G20 summit which held in India in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harsh Vardhan Shringla**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harsh Vardhan Shringla** was the** chief coordinator for the G20 summit held in India in 2023**.
 
• The G20 summit is a significant international forum for governments and central bank governors from **19 countries and the European Union**.
 
• India hosted the G20 summit in 2023, focusing on **global economic issues, international financial stability, climate change mitigation, and sustainable development**.
 
• As the chief coordinator, Shringla played a crucial role in organizing and managing the summit's logistics, agenda, and diplomatic engagements.
 
• His extensive experience in diplomacy and international relations was instrumental in ensuring the summit's success.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Harsh Vardhan Shringla is a seasoned diplomat who has served as India's Foreign Secretary and Ambassador to the United States, among other significant positions.
 
• The G20 summit in 2023 was an important platform for India to showcase its leadership on global economic issues and to strengthen international cooperation.
 
• India's presidency of the G20 highlighted its commitment to addressing pressing global challenges and promoting inclusive growth.
